posts.title: The King's address in Dubai: Shahrukhz by Danube
posts.deck: A boy from Ghatkopar built the tower. Gauri Khan designed its penthouses, and they sold out on launch day. Karan Johar hosted the night. And at the end of it, Shah Rukh Khan brought KING to Dubai.
posts.img_alt: Shah Rukh Khan on stage at the Shahrukhz Residences by Danube launch in Dubai
posts.img_credit: Shah Rukh Khan at the launch of Shahrukhz Residences by Danube, Coca-Cola Arena, Dubai, 11 November 2026. Photo: SRK Russian FC on X.

blocks.p: On Wednesday night the Coca-Cola Arena in Dubai filled for a building. Not a film, not a concert: a 60-storey waterfront tower in Dubai Maritime City that carries Shah Rukh Khan's name. Shahrukhz Residences by Danube is the second tower the developer has named after him, and by the time he walked on stage, the evening had already become a family affair, a friendship and a film promotion, all at once.

The tower belongs to Rizwan Sajan, and his own story would make a Shah Rukh Khan film. He was born in Mumbai in 1963 and grew up in Ghatkopar. He lost his father at 16 and left school to work, selling books, delivering milk and newspapers, and selling firecrackers at Diwali, Business Today reported. A job in building materials took him to Kuwait; the Gulf War sent him home. In the early 1990s a friend helped him to Dubai, where he started trading hardware. That trading business became Danube Group, today one of Dubai's big home builders. Reports put his own worth at about $2.5 billion.

He first put Shah Rukh Khan's name on a building in 2025: Shahrukhz by Danube, a commercial tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, which Danube says sold out on launch day. Wednesday was the reunion. On stage, the two men played it like old friends. Asked by Karan Johar what he would take from the actor, Sajan picked the dimples: with those, he said, he would sell twice as much property. Shah Rukh Khan's answer: then who would watch his films? Sajan also told the arena the advice the actor once gave him: you build the tower, leave the show to me.

fig.alt: Shah Rukh Khan with Rizwan Sajan on stage in Dubai
fig.cap: Shah Rukh Khan with Danube Group founder Rizwan Sajan on stage. Fan clubs said he treated Sajan to a dialogue from Raees. Photo: SRK Chennai FC on X.

blocks.h: Gauri's penthouses, sold on launch day

blocks.p: The penthouses at the top of the tower are Gauri Khan's. She designed them with her team in India, and on stage she called the project “so personal.” Danube's Adel Sajan, Rizwan's son, said she sat in on every Zoom call and worked through every detail, down to the materials and the corners of each room. Bringing her in was his father's idea.

All of her penthouses, valued at ₹50 crore each, sold out on launch day, Gulf Good News reported, and fan clubs at the arena posted that they were gone before the evening began. Shah Rukh Khan, for his part, told the arena that at home Gauri decides everything, from the Wi-Fi to the chandeliers. Then he turned to her: “Gauri, what a home you've made.”

fig.alt: Rizwan Sajan, Shah Rukh Khan, Gauri Khan and Karan Johar on stage
fig.cap: Rizwan Sajan, Shah Rukh Khan, Gauri Khan and Karan Johar on stage at the Coca-Cola Arena. Photo: Gulf News.

blocks.h: Karan Johar, on his own couch

blocks.p: Karan Johar hosted the night, and he brought his couch. The man who directed Shah Rukh Khan in Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna and My Name Is Khan ran the evening like an episode of his own talk show: an introduction for Gauri, a rapid-fire round for Sajan, and the questions that turned the night from property to life.

On that couch, Shah Rukh Khan talked about houses. “My biggest yearning in life was to have a house,” he said, Khaleej Times reported. Gulf News reported that he traced that wish back to a childhood without the home he wanted, and called buying his first home, and later Mannat, two of the least practical decisions of his life. Mannat is now a stop for fans and tourists in Bandra. Now there is an address in Dubai with his name on it. He called that “extremely humbling.”

Before he sat down, he danced. Shah Rukh Khan performed Tu Mil Jaaye, KING's first song, released on his 61st birthday on 2 November. Fan clubs on X called it the song's first live performance. On Instagram, 104 posts about the launch had 4,493,209 plays by Thursday morning. Tu Mil Jaaye itself passed 74.8 million views on YouTube. KING opens in cinemas on 24 December, in the UAE as well. Forty-two days to go.

posts.title: Ramayana's first week: ₹511.10 crore
posts.deck: Ramayana: Part 1 made ₹70.65 crore on Wednesday and closed seven days at ₹511.10 crore net in India, according to Sacnilk. Worldwide: ₹934.55 crore gross.

blocks.p: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1 collected ₹70.65 crore net in India on Wednesday 11 November, its seventh day, from 24,239 shows, according to Sacnilk's figures updated at 10:11 PM IST. That is 24.9% below Tuesday's ₹94.10 crore, and it took the film past ₹500 crore net. Average occupancy was 43.4%.

Sacnilk's own note on the run: the Hindi version has brought in 77.1% of the India net so far, and the Malayalam version had the fullest halls on Wednesday at 68.0%. Its day 8 report, for Thursday, will close the first full week; a week counts from Thursday to Thursday.
KING opens on Thursday 24 December, 42 days from today. With a Thursday release, its first week will also run eight days, Christmas to New Year, and it will be read against these numbers.

posts.title: MAATRUBHUMI to KING: the Karan Arjun of Bollywood
posts.deck: Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi released its trailer last night. It opens on 4 December, twenty days before Shah Rukh Khan's KING.
posts.img_credit: Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace, official trailer · Salman Khan Films on YouTube. Tap the picture to watch.

blocks.p: A friendship that’s talked about, written about , read about and discussed by millions for decades, but behind the closed doors of paradise, FANS donot really have any real knowledge or data about the “real friendship” between the two other than their public performance. Even the so called famous spat they had in 2008 at some private party, and apparently didn't speak until the iftaar party of 2013, the real world outside the doors of this Bollywood castle, there is no telling what the reality was. With all the social media and 24/7 press , the doors of the castle are tightly shut to reality for the common man.

Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace released its official trailer on the Salman Khan Films YouTube channel at 10:25 PM IST on Tuesday 10 November. It runs 4 minutes 35 seconds. The film is directed by Apoorva Lakhia and produced by Salma Khan, and was earlier titled Battle of Galwan.

Salman Khan plays the commander of a battalion posted on the northern border. The role is based on Colonel B. Santosh Babu of the 16 Bihar Regiment, The Hollywood Reporter India reported. Chitrangda Singh plays his wife. His men fight in the snow with clubs, stones, shields and bare hands, not guns, and the border scenes cut to the couple’s love story. The channel’s own line for the trailer: “the greatest victory is when war comes to an end.”

links: Watch the official trailer on YouTube

stats: read 11 Nov 11:11 IST, about 12¾ hours after upload

blocks.p: In 1995 the two of them were brothers who died and came back because their mother would not stop calling them. “Mere Karan Arjun aayenge.” Thirty-one years later the calendar has set them twenty days apart. One comes back on 4 December as a soldier for Maatrubhumi, the motherland. The other comes back on 24 December as KING.

Shah Rukh Khan wore the uniform first. His first role on screen was Lieutenant Abhimanyu Rai in Fauji (1989). He wore it again as Major Ram in Main Hoon Na and as Squadron Leader Veer Pratap Singh in Veer-Zaara (both 2004), a soldier who crossed the border for love, not for war. Then came Major Samar Anand in Jab Tak Hai Jaan (2012). Salman Khan went to the China border once before, in Tubelight (2017), a story set during the war of 1962. Maatrubhumi takes him back there, to Galwan.

quote.q: Kisi sarhad ka, main sipahi na banta.
Fauji ki vardi ka koi karza na hota

blocks.p: These lines seem to sum up the trailer. In the song, the man who would be King refuses the border. In the trailer, the man at the border fights with bare hands, and the film’s own title asks for war to rest in peace. They come from opposite ends of the same line: one from the man who will not wear the uniform, the other from the man inside it. They arrive at the same place.

audio.sub: Lyrics: Shailja Gupta · free to everyone

blocks.p: On screen, they keep turning up for each other: Tiger on the train in Pathaan, Pathaan in Tiger 3. Off screen, fans have only the public record. This December gives them something new: two films, twenty days apart, and the numbers to go with them. From today, SRK DAILY tracks MAATRUBHUMI to KING every day. The point is not who wins. The point is whether the fans of both turn up for both.

Maatrubhumi has put out a teaser (27 December 2025, Salman Khan’s 60th birthday), five songs on the Salman Khan Films Music channel between January and November, and now the trailer. Its biggest video is still the teaser. Its songs have been out for weeks or months; KING’s first song has been out for nine days.

posts.title: Bandra's Gaiety-Galaxy races to reopen for KING
posts.deck: Shut since September, Bandra's landmark G7 cinema complex wants its doors open before KING's Christmas release, Mid-Day reported. Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi, KING's first December rival, released its trailer last night.

blocks.p: Gaiety-Galaxy, the G7 multiplex in Bandra, is working to reopen in the last week of November, Mid-Day reported on Tuesday 10 November. The theatre has been shut since 7 September. According to the paper, its management does not want to miss two of December's biggest Hindi releases: Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi on 4 December and KING on 24 December.

The closure followed a police inquiry that found the cinema's entertainment premises licence had allegedly not been renewed since 2021, MovieTalkies reported, citing The Indian Express; a case was registered against the owner, the manager and the operating firm. The management has described it as a technical shutdown caused by burnt cables. The police have said the theatre can reopen once the licence is renewed.

Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace, directed by Apoorva Lakhia, released its trailer on the Salman Khan Films YouTube channel at 10:25 PM on Tuesday. By 7:10 AM on Wednesday it had 4,245,759 views. It opens 20 days before KING.

stats: read 11 Nov 07:10 IST, about 9 hours after upload

blocks.h: A poster on Ramayana's busiest day

blocks.p: KING's makers also used Ramayana's record Monday. On 9 November, the day after Diwali, fans on X posted screenshots showing the KING poster on the BookMyShow app as people booked tickets for Ramayana, The Lallantop reported. When the Hindi site checked the app on the morning of 10 November, the poster was no longer there.

Red Chillies Entertainment posted the song's full version twice more on Tuesday, at 11 AM and 7:47 PM, both signed off "#KING in cinemas on 24.12.2026". On X, fan clubs in Bengaluru, Chennai and Andhra Pradesh celebrated the song on Spotify, and fan trackers counted more than 200,000 Instagram reels made to it in nine days.

BJP MLA Ravinder Negi repeated his demand that Deepika Padukone's saffron-outfit sequences be cut from the film, speaking to PTI on 9 November, the Free Press Journal reported. He said protests had begun in Maharashtra and would continue in Delhi until the scenes were removed.

posts.title: KING finds its Kerala home
posts.deck: E4 Entertainment will take KING to Kerala's cinemas in both Hindi and Tamil, Sacnilk reported. Back in the charts, Tu Mil Jaaye crossed 70 million YouTube views on its ninth day.

blocks.p: KING has its distributor for Kerala. E4 Entertainment, the company led by Mukesh R. Mehta and C. V. Sarathi, will handle the Hindi and Tamil theatrical versions of Shah Rukh Khan's Christmas release in the state, Sacnilk reported on Monday 9 November. The screen count and the terms of the deal have not been made public.

Releasing a Hindi film in Tamil as well is a deliberate play for Kerala, where Tamil cinema has long had a large audience. E4 Entertainment also took Ramayana to Kerala this Diwali, according to Sacnilk.

blocks.h: The Kerala numbers KING will be measured against

stats: Kerala gross, as reported by Sacnilk
a Hindi-film record at the time

blocks.p: Sacnilk's Kerala chart for Hindi films is led by Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge at over ₹19 crore gross; Jawan and Pathaan are second and third. A third Shah Rukh Khan film near the top would complete what Sacnilk calls a hat-trick.

Kerala joins the distribution deals already reported for KING: Pen Marudhar for all-India theatrical rights at about ₹250 crore, and Phars Films for the overseas release on a reported ₹175 crore minimum guarantee. Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures produce; Siddharth Anand directs. KING opens on 24 December, 44 days from today.

Red Chillies Entertainment kept the song in front of fans on Monday with a full-version streaming post at 6 PM, after a third post for 19 years of Om Shanti Om at 1 PM; both signed off "#KING in cinemas on 24.12.2026". On X, fan clubs celebrated the song staying at No. 1 on YouTube's trending list, and Team SRK Pune announced a first-day-first-show for more than 1,100 fans.

posts.title: An apology: no SRK DAILY on 8 November

blocks.p: SRK DAILY did not publish an edition on Saturday, 8 November. We apologise to our readers.

The reason: that day's KING Buzz numbers were collected and filed, but the paper itself was not yet set to publish on a fixed daily schedule. It went out only when an edition was started by hand, and on 8 November none was started.
That has now changed. From 10 November SRK DAILY is produced every morning and published on the site, and on our LinkedIn page at 12:00 noon IST, every day.

posts.title: Tu Mil Jaaye meets its first boycott call
posts.deck: A Delhi BJP MLA wants Deepika Padukone's orange-outfit sequence cut from KING's first song. The song kept climbing: 68.4 million YouTube views on its eighth day.

blocks.p: KING's first song has its first political fight. BJP MLA Ravi Negi, who represents Delhi's Patparganj constituency, has demanded that the makers remove the sequence in Tu Mil Jaaye in which Deepika Padukone dances with Shah Rukh Khan in an orange outfit, and has called for a nationwide boycott of the film if they do not, Moneycontrol and The Telegraph reported on 6 and 7 November.

quote.q: If Shah Rukh Khan does not remove the bhagwa scene, we will call for a nationwide boycott of King.
quote.by: Ravi Negi, BJP MLA, speaking to Dainik Samachar (as quoted by Moneycontrol, 7 Nov 2026)

blocks.p: In the same interview Negi called the actor a "Jihadi", Moneycontrol and The Daily Star reported. On 7 November Ayodhya's Mahant Sitaram Das Maharaj told ANI that a dance in saffron "would not be tolerated" and suggested the actress wear green instead, according to Bhaskar English.

The row repeats December 2022, when Deepika Padukone's saffron outfit in Besharam Rang, a song from Pathaan, drew protests and a threatened ban in Madhya Pradesh. Siddharth Anand, who directs KING, said then that the colour was chosen for the song's sunny backdrop. Pathaan opened in January 2023 and went on to become one of the highest-grossing Hindi films of all time. MovieTalkies summed up this week's echo: same colour, same actress, same actor, same director.

On social media, fans answered the boycott call with jokes and reels, iDiva reported. Red Chillies Entertainment kept posting: a full-version streaming link on 8 November, Diwali wishes the same evening and, this morning, two posts for 19 years of Om Shanti Om, the film that first paired Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone, each signed off "#KING in cinemas on 24.12.2026".

posts.title: Agar Main King Hota: the final mix, and sheet music for every fan
posts.deck: The final version of the site's song is out, 6 minutes and 49 seconds, with a new poster of the King and his saxophone, and free sheet music for every instrument.

blocks.p: A day after its release, Agar Main King Hota has its final mix. The song, created by Shailja Gupta using Claude, ChatGPT and Suno, now plays on the site in its finished form, with a new poster, the lyrics as they are sung, and sheet music that anyone can download for free.

The new poster puts the King on a bridge at night, in the rain, a saxophone at his lips and a red crown above his head. Its line reads 'Based on SRK's Real Tech Career': the song is a documentary of that career, from Aryan Infomatics and SRKWorld to Little G.ONE.
The saxophone is the King's instrument in the song too. It carries the long break at 2:57 and returns before the bridge, answering the voice where the violin used to.

Every instrument has its own sheet: vocals, alto sax in E♭, violin, guitar, bass and drums, plus a full score for a conductor. Each comes as a PDF to print, a MusicXML file to open in MuseScore, Sibelius or Finale, and a MIDI file to hear the part. A band, a school or a fan with a guitar can play the whole song from them, at no cost.

quote.by: Agar Main King Hota, the last line, sung twice

blocks.p: The lyrics on the song page now follow the recording line by line, with every chorus, instrumental and the bridge marked. The song closes on 'Agar main tu hota', almost whispered and sung twice, a line left for the King himself.

posts.title: Agar Main King Hota: the song is out
posts.deck: The site's own song, created by Shailja Gupta, is out today: six minutes and 47 seconds of a fan's India, from Bombay to Ladakh, that ends in one line, 'Agar main tu hota'.

blocks.p: Agar Main King Hota, the song this site is named after, was released on Friday 6 November. It was created by Shailja Gupta, using Claude, ChatGPT and Suno, and it plays in full on the site from today.

blocks.h: A map of India, line by line

blocks.p: The song opens on a single question and then walks the country, one city to a line: Bombay is home, Madras the Taj Mahal, Calcutta the adda, Dilli the sky, Kashmir destiny, Darjeeling the fog. A second verse goes on to Lucknow, Banaras, Amritsar, Punjab, Hyderabad, Kerala, Goa, Kanyakumari and Ladakh. Every line ends the same way, 'hota': what would be, if.

quote.q: Chehra mera, sirf mera hi hota, / Awaaz meri, par naam sirf tera hota

blocks.p: Halfway through, the song stops being a king's wish list. The face and the voice become the subject, the same fight the fans' anthem INQUILAAB KING KE SAATH took up on 28 October: a star's face, voice and name belong to him. Then comes the confession of a fan, and a last verse that drops the crown altogether.
It ends quietly, on 'Agar main tu hota': if I were you.

posts.title: Ramayana's first day: ₹64.85 crore
posts.deck: Ramayana: Part 1 opened at ₹64.85 crore net in India, according to Sacnilk. Jawan's ₹75 crore opening day is still the mark KING is chasing on 24 December.

blocks.p: Ramayana: Part 1 opened on Thursday 5 November, in five languages. By the end of the night, the first-day numbers were in.

Kannada (₹7.25 crore), Telugu (₹6.00 crore), Tamil (₹2.60 crore) and Malayalam (₹1.50 crore) make up the rest. Bollywood Hungama reports the opening day at ₹62.50 crore. Overseas: N/A, not yet reported.
Ramayana sold more tickets in advance than Jawan, but Jawan's first day is still higher. Advance booking is a promise. Day one is the walk-in crowd.

KING opens in 48 days, on 24 December, Christmas Eve. The two numbers to watch are now set: the Hindi opening-day record and the ₹75 crore that Jawan put up in 2023. Ramayana's run over the Diwali weekend will show how big this season's audience is.

posts.title: Tu Mil Jaaye: 1 lakh reels in four days, #1 on Instagram
posts.deck: KING's first song has crossed 1 lakh reels on Instagram in under four days and is trending at #1. By 09:20 IST this morning the count stood at 117,000.

blocks.p: Tu Mil Jaaye, the first song from KING, has crossed 1 lakh reels on Instagram in less than four days and is trending at number one on the platform, Team Shah Rukh Khan, SRK's official fan club, announced at 09:01 IST on Friday. Twenty minutes later, the song's audio page on Instagram stood at 117,000 reels.
The 117,000 counts only reels made with the official audio. Reels set to fan re-uploads of the song sit on separate audio pages, so the full number is higher.

Views count people who watched. Reels count people who made something with the song: a dance, a lip-sync, a couple's video, a fan edit. In four days, more than a lakh fans put KING's first song into their own videos, 48 days before the film opens on 24 December.

posts.title: Ramayana opens, and the season begins
posts.deck: Ramayana: Part 1 is in cinemas today with the second-biggest opening-day advance booking ever reported for a Bollywood film. KING follows on 24 December.

blocks.p: Diwali week, Thursday 5 November 2026. Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1, produced by Namit Malhotra, with Ranbir Kapoor as Ram, Yash as Ravana and Sai Pallavi as Sita, opened in cinemas this morning.

stats: Tickets sold before the first show

blocks.p: As reported by Sacnilk at 10:08 IST, that is the second-highest opening-day advance booking for a Bollywood film, behind Dhurandhar 2 (₹52.35 crore) and ahead of Jawan (₹40.75 crore). Koimoi reports it as the highest ever for a film that is not a sequel. These are reported pre-sales, not box office.

stats: still being counted; the final figure is due tomorrow

blocks.p: Live trackers were showing different day-one numbers through the morning, so we print N/A until a final figure is reported.

list: Hindustan Times: 4 stars (as reported by Marksmen Daily)

blocks.p: The common thread: the scale, the visual effects and Yash's Ravana are praised; the slow first half and the music divide the critics. Part 1 builds the world. The battle is saved for Part 2.

Ramayana's pre-sales passed Jawan's. The bar for a big Hindi opening has just been raised, 49 days before KING opens on 24 December. This season is a relay, not a clash: Ramayana at Diwali, KING at Christmas.

posts.title: RAMAYANA to KING: the release-day report
posts.deck: Every official YouTube video of both films, read at 12:40 IST on Ramayana's opening day. Two days ago they were level.

blocks.p: On 3 November the two films were level, with KING 324,348 views ahead. Since then KING's first song has pulled away: Tu Mil Jaaye alone added 10,732,163 views, more than four times what Ramayana's seven videos added together (2,356,467).

blocks.p: Day three ran at about 319,000 views an hour. Day four is about 246,000: still climbing, at a steadier pace.

KING's two official teasers have 84,493,381 YouTube views together; the Avengers: Doomsday trailer has 83,931,977. KING's lead is 561,404, up from 515,054 yesterday. Not like-for-like: two videos against one, and KING has not released a trailer yet.
Not like-for-like either: seven videos against three, and a film on its release day against one 49 days away. The race that counts starts at the box office.

posts.title: Agar Main King Hota, and how the King turned 61
posts.deck: What this fans' KING world is, and the story so far: from the song at midnight on his birthday to a 24-hour record.
posts.img_alt: Tu Mil Jaaye, released the minute he turned 61

blocks.h: What Agar Main King Hota is

blocks.p: Agar Main King Hota, if I were the King, is the question every Shah Rukh Khan fan has asked at least once. This site is where the fans answer it: a fan-built world around KING, Shah Rukh Khan's film that opens on 24 December 2026. Not a campaign you watch; one you enter.

Play: Rescue Your Face (12 arcade games in 2 worlds), Chess81 and its 81-second Rapid Fire, and BAAHEIN KHOL, the signature-pose game
KING Buzz: KING's buzz published in public every day against a fixed baseline, real numbers or N/A
INQUILAAB KING KE SAATH: the fans' own anthem against celebrity persona theft by Big Tech, #FreeMyFace #FreeMyVoice #FreeMyName
KING University: Shah Rukh Khan studied the way history studies its emperors, Pre-K to PhD, from 1947 to 2026
Asoka to Boo-Da: the book, SRK: The Man, The Myth, The King; plus the Gallery, On The Record and Character Study

blocks.p: Everything here is made by fans, for fans, and every number is one we read ourselves. SRK DAILY is where we write it up, every day, until KING and beyond.
Shah Rukh Khan vs. the clock. Toss won by the King, elected to bat at midnight.

time: No balcony. The man who has waved from Mannat almost every birthday since 2007 sent a handwritten note instead, lit across the scaffolding of his own home: "Thank you all for your wishes and love. Sending mine right back to you all. Lots of love and a big hug."

First ball. KING's first song, Tu Mil Jaaye, drops on YouTube the minute he turns 61. Sachin-Jigar, Kumaar, Arijit Singh, Madhubanti Bagchi, and Ed Sheeran in a Hindi film song. Shah Rukh and Deepika on screen.
His own post: "Of Love and other Battles... This December, #LoveLikeAKing"

blocks.p: We read the YouTube counter every 10 minutes, all day.
His Instagram reel, same 22 hours 55 minutes: 1.3 million likes, 62,100 comments, 51,000 shares.

5,000+ fans in Mumbai (an SRK Universe fan-club estimate, via PTI). Police barricades 500 metres from his gate. Fans screening DDLJ, feeding an orphanage, running free health check-ups. The Burj Khalifa saying "WE LOVE YOU SRK". The Bandra-Worli Sea Link carrying his face the night before.

After skipping the balcony in 2024 and 2025, and with Mannat wrapped in scaffolding, he walked out anyway. White T-shirt, beanie, a platform built just for the moment. Waved. Bowed. Folded his hands. Opened his arms.
Late night, the party outside Mannat went on, and he came back out. Kisses blown, the signature pose, the street singing his name.
3 November, 17:26 IST, 41 hours 17 minutes in: 41,796,168 views and 500,181 likes. Half a million likes before the second sunset. By 21:15 IST: 43,451,423 views.
Day one ran at about 1.5 million views an hour. Day two settled at about 357,000 an hour, the normal second-day curve for a song that has already been everywhere.

The fans did the rest. In three days we counted 127 new YouTube videos about the song and the birthday (reactions, reviews, covers, remixes, AI versions) and 176 fan-made posts on Instagram and X, each checked by hand.

And the season's scoreboard moved too. KING's two official teasers together had 84,010,198 YouTube views, past the Avengers: Doomsday trailer's 83,646,111. Ramayana: Part 1 opens on 5 November; all seven of its official videos add up to 127,204,303 views. KING's three: 127,528,651. Dead level, 51 days before KING opens.

Hindustan Times, Bollywood Hungama and UNI report, from the makers' own numbers, that Tu Mil Jaaye became the most-watched Indian film song on YouTube in its first 24 hours: 36.3 million views and 430,000 likes, past Zinda Banda from Jawan (34.6 million, as reported). That is the makers' figure as carried by the press, not a post from @iamsrk or @redchilliesent.

Our own log agrees with it. We read the public YouTube counter every 10 minutes on his birthday: 35,243,482 views and 416,961 likes at 23:04 IST, 22 hours 55 minutes after release. UNI and DNA also report more than 60 million views across all digital platforms in a day; we only count YouTube.
On agarmainkinghota.com, the fans' own KING campaign, we publish KING's buzz in public every day against a fixed baseline. Real numbers only; if we can't read it, it says N/A.
